title: Digital Kitabe: code and data
description:
Code and data accompanying the article Serialization-Stable, Localizable Identity for IFC Models: Canonical Merkle Commitment with a Pattern-Based Visual Layer (submitted to the Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering).

The Digital Kitabe is a model identity computed from the content of an IFC model through a canonical Merkle commitment (DK-C14N-1.1), stored inside the model with standard IFC entities, sealed in a signed append-only record and rendered as a pattern generated from historical geometric pattern grammars (DK-ENC-1.1; DK-ENC-1.0 kept for comparison).

paper/: code that reproduces the experiments and figures of the article, and the reported results (Merkle trees, signed test ledger, patterns). tool/: command-line tool to stamp, verify and identify IFC models. The Snowdon Towers sample model (Autodesk) is not included.

Code: MIT licence. Data in paper/results/: CC BY 4.0.
